title: A JSON settings file
description:
Save and load settings with `System.Text.Json`.

```
No settings yet; using defaults
Saved: {"theme":"dark","fontSize":16,"recent":["a.txt"]}
Loaded: dark, 16, 1 recent file
```
hints: `Deserialize` can return `null` (for the text `null`), so write `?? new Settings()`.
requirements: `record Settings(string Theme = "light", int FontSize = 14, List<string>? Recent = null)`.
`Load(path)` returns the defaults when the file is missing or the JSON is broken (`JsonException`).
stretch: Write the file safely: save to `settings.json.tmp`, then `File.Move(tmp, path, overwrite: true)`.
